name: House 666
source:
In the late fall of 1975, freelancer detective Edward Arcanus goes to the infamous town of Insigma, determined to uncover the mysteries within its borders. Once being a satanic town as well as the secret experimentation zone of the Nazi regime, the entire history of the town is veiled in bloodshed and madness. However, the truth might be too much for him to handle as he begins his exploration of House 666...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=13077]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
1975年深秋，自由侦探爱德华·阿卡纳斯前往臭名昭著的因西格玛镇，决心揭开镇界之内隐藏的谜团。这里曾是一座崇拜撒旦的城镇，也是纳粹政权的秘密实验区，整段历史都笼罩在鲜血与疯狂之中。然而，当爱德华开始探索666号宅邸时，他所发现的真相或许已远远超出自己能够承受的极限……
